gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-halant: Woodgod has a wide channel cut into every bowl, giving it a worn, vintage bark. And Halant is the one that lets the paragraph speak, with a faint dip-pen shift in its strokes and a towering x-height.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-hedvig-letters-ser: Hedvig Letters Serif reads with open-ended curves and a sturdy, tall-bodied lowercase, its contrast moderate and unhurried. Woodgod stands over it with commanding vintage weight, and a larger size for the heading would suit that.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-marcellus-sc: Woodgod's lowercase climbs nearly to the capitals, and a wide channel opens into every bowl. Marcellus SC takes up that stature with gentle modulation and pulled-back terminals, a dignified text serif that gives the pair its literary spine.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-montagu-slab: Woodgod comes in commanding and vintage, with low stroke variation and a wide channel into each bowl. But Montagu Slab is the serif that handles the reading, its robust downstrokes and slender turns moving at a restful pace.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-serif-hentaig: Vintage muscle, then refined restraint: Woodgod brings tall lowercase letters that nearly touch the capitals, while the serif below carries visible modulation and open jaws on its curves. They share that tall stance.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-ovo: Woodgod is commanding and vintage, its lowercase nearly capital height. Ovo, the serif beside it, adds a visible but restrained gap between thick and thin, and that quiet shift from one to the other is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-unbounded-fs-epilogue: Unbounded spreads its lettering wide, with oversized lowercase bodies and a broad, welcoming opening on the c, like neon tubing. Epilogue follows with curvy, wire-like monoline sans letters, tall and loose.
gen-unbounded-fs-public-sans: Wide, friendly, and a bit oversized: that is Unbounded, its lettering spreading out with a generous opening on the c. Public Sans settles underneath with a hefty lowercase body and broad open counters, trustworthy and sturdy.
gen-unbounded-general-sans: Unbounded spreads its oversized lowercase wide and keeps a welcoming opening on the c, which is a friendly, contemporary look. It earns its keep big and short, while General Sans follows with smooth sans-serif curves.
gen-butcherman-inter: Inter has big counters in a tall lowercase, breathing like a hollow reed cut open, smooth as tubing along each line. Butcherman, with its dark, raw letters and slot-like apertures, sits against that openness, and the closed-versus-open tension is the pair's strongest quality.
